format_divergence.reason_en: Sixth of eight, same reasoning throughout: a receptive module has nothing for a transform or error-spot question to test. Six are now written this way. Reworking them is a contained job today and a much larger one once levels 31 to 40 are in.

questions.question_en: Listen again. What is the outcome of the call?
questions.explanation_en: Wednesday is full, so गुरुवार को आना होगा — and शाम पाँच बजे.

questions.question_en: Listen again. How is the disagreement resolved?
options: The date stands as it was
questions.explanation_en: एक हफ़्ता और ले लें? — and उतना काफ़ी होगा accepts it.

questions.question_en: Across the leave dialogues, what has been handled while he was away?
options: Two meetings happened and the notes were sent
The project was handed to a client
questions.explanation_en: दो मीटिंग हुई थीं, and नोट्स भेज दिए हैं.

questions.question_en: You hear मैंने अमित से करवा लिया and प्रिया को समझा दीजिए. Why से in one and को in the other?
options: से marks the person who does the work; को marks the person acted on
से is used with names and को with pronouns
से is formal and को is informal
questions.explanation_en: Amit did the report, so से. Priya is the one being explained to, so को. Both are Module 11's causative rules in an office.

questions.question_en: In मैंने तो लगाया था, what is तो doing?
options: Carrying the emphasis English would put on the verb
questions.explanation_en: "I DID attach it." Hindi inserts a word where English stresses a syllable — the same job तो did in दी तो थी back in level 3.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: अभी पक्का नहीं है। ___ अभी टिकट बुक नहीं किया।
questions.question_read_as: abhii pakkaa nahiiṁ hai. ___ abhii ṭikaṭ buk nahiiṁ kiyaa.
questions.explanation_en: करना is transitive and perfective, so ने — even in the negative.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: एक मिनट है? ज़रा ये देख ___ हैं?
questions.question_read_as: ek minaṭ hai? zaraa ye dekh ___ haiṁ?
questions.explanation_en: The colleague addressed is a woman, so सकती — with हैं for the respectful आप.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: हाँ, बहुत ___ ने छुट्टी ली है।
questions.question_read_as: haaṁ, bahut ___ ne chhuṭṭii lii hai.
questions.explanation_en: ने is a postposition like any other, so the plural goes oblique in front of it.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: बारह ___ के बाद, शायद एक बजे।
questions.question_read_as: baarah ___ ke baad, shaayad ek baje.
questions.explanation_en: बजा goes oblique to बजे before के बाद — and clock times are always in that form.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: सोमवार ___ हो जाएगा।
questions.explanation_en: तक for the far end — by Monday.
